title: Knights’ Tales Silver Coin Set SU
descriptionPlain: The complete Knights’ Tales series stored in a wood-look case made of reinforced card, this set contains all five silver coins, Chivalry, Adventure, Courage, Fortitude and Brotherhood, in their corresponding blister pack. Whether for collecting or giving, this complete coin set is ideal for the adventurous.This set has a size of approximately 19 x 11 x 2 cm.
